gen-nixie-one-gf-ibm-plex-sans-arabic: Nostalgic and a bit retro-tech, Nixie One draws its curves with clear gaps and one constant stroke. IBM Plex Sans Arabic is the plain sans that reads easily.
gen-nixie-one-gf-ibm-plex-sans-hebrew: Nixie One draws every letter with an uninterrupted line, like a thin wire bent into shape. IBM Plex Sans Hebrew follows in a contemporary, approachable voice, its s and c mouths open and uncrowded, so the retro heading gets a modern partner.
gen-nixie-one-gf-ibm-plex-sans-jp: Professional yet approachable, IBM Plex Sans JP ends each curve in a clean open gap, while Nixie One keeps its round letters as heavy as its straight ones. Text flows smoothly beneath the heading.
gen-nixie-one-gf-ibm-plex-sans-kr: Retro-tech lines, each traced with a single stylus. IBM Plex Sans KR keeps openness at every curve end, so a long passage feels modern and easy to move through.
gen-nixie-one-gf-ibm-plex-sans-thai: Every stroke end on Nixie One looks cut from the same ribbon, giving the heading its nostalgic, retro-tech charm. IBM Plex Sans Thai answers with c shapes whose ends point apart like open pincers, a contemporary counterweight.
gen-nixie-one-gf-ibm-plex-sans-thai-loop: Clean and neutral, IBM Plex Sans Thai Looped lets its curves refuse to close, which keeps text feeling light. Nixie One bends its letters like tubing for nostalgic flair.
gen-nixie-one-gf-imprima: Nixie One brings a nostalgic, retro-tech hum, its curves open and its stroke constant from top to baseline. Imprima follows with a smooth, tube-like sans whose terminals flare outward, so a generous heading size lets the two breathe.
gen-nixie-one-gf-inclusive-sans: Nostalgic and retro-tech, Nixie One keeps its curves open with a constant stroke from top to baseline. Inclusive Sans matches its rims to its stems, a professional plain sans.
gen-nixie-one-gf-inria-sans: Retro-tech and tubular, with open curves you can see through. Inria Sans carries the same bent copper pipe feel into body text, so the nostalgic Nixie One heading and the contemporary lines below feel related.
gen-nixie-one-gf-istok-web: Istok Web brings rounded letters with a clearly open side, a modern and approachable voice for the body text. Nixie One adds nostalgic bars of identical thickness across the line.
